evd_title: GPT-4 achieved F1 0.80 for accurate citations but only 0.09 for not-accurate citations
finding: GPT-4 achieved F1 0.80 for accurate citations but only 0.09 for not-accurate citations
P: Held-out test citations from Sarol corpus (100 PMC-OA biomedical refs, 3063 citations)
I: GPT-4 and GPT-3.5-turbo-0613, 4-shot in-context learning with reasoning; top-5 BM25+MonoT5 evidence
C: Gold human annotations; MultiVerS baseline and top-20; oracle
O: GPT-4 F1: ACCURATE 0.80 (recall 0.90), NOT_ACCURATE 0.09 vs MultiVerS 0.43; GPT-3.5 0.05; GPT-4 micro 0.65, macro 0.45
S: Few-shot LLM evaluation against annotated corpus
